ASU Universal Learner Courses

Take online Arizona State University courses without joining an ASU degree program. Eligible courses can become university-issued credit.

Browse ASU courses

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

See where 7 ASU Universal Learner courses count in researched degree plans

Study format
Asynchronous sessions or on-demand courses. On-demand minimums depend on credits: six weeks for three/four credits, four weeks for two, two weeks for one.
Pricing
Official pricing lists $25 enrollment plus an optional $400 credit-conversion payment per course ($425 if converted).
Assessments
Assessment and proctoring vary by course; required proctored assessments use Honorlock. Check prerequisites and release schedules.
Credit type
Arizona State University academic credit after successful completion and optional credit purchase.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

Arizona State University academic credit after successful completion and optional credit purchase.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
